Complementary discovery located Kausaali, a Scala 3 repository with causal-forest and generalized-forest code. At the inspected September 2026 revision, its file named \texttt{InstrumentalForest.scala} explicitly contains an unimplemented placeholder; its three instrumental-forest tests are pending. The public generalized-forest factory inspected here exposes causal and regression constructors. The placeholder describes proposed observation, moment, guard, leaf and weighted-estimator extensions. These comments are evidence of intended development, not evidence that the instrumental estimator works or that the cited scholarly guarantees have been inherited. The source build declares Scala 3.3.5 and Apache-2.0 metadata. A README badge and Maven coordinates do not authenticate a released binary or prove that a binary contains the proposed estimator.~\citep{exec25_javaiv_kausaali}

The intended weighted-Wald extension raises a substantive contract issue even before implementation. In an authored two-component example, let numerator terms be two and four, and denominator terms one and four, with equal component weights. Averaging the two local ratios gives $\tfrac12(2+1)=1.5$, whereas dividing the summed numerator by the summed denominator gives $6/5=1.2$. Neither operation can silently replace the other. A proposed forest adapter must specify the moment being solved and retain the kernel weights and weak-denominator state. Conditional exclusion, relevance and the population interpretation remain additional scientific requirements. A placeholder provides a development lead; it supplies no IV or RD admission.~\citep{exec25_javaiv_kausaali,exec25_javaiv_choice}
